savoir: The absence of a validation button is desired: the translation is recalculated each time the source text is changed.
The regeneration button on the “Rephrasing” tab is precisely used to request a result when the first is not appropriate.
The same sentence can return an identical result after regeneration: this is the behavior observed, then go through the “alternatives” panel.
articles.question: Why is the translation not starting?

articles.title: My file is rejected for Corrext: what to do · Neur.on
articles.description: A rejected file almost always stems from its format, weight of more than 50 MB, or the number of files filed at once, limited to 25.
articles.reponse: A file rejected by Corrext is almost always due to one of three causes: a format outside the accepted list, weighing more than 50 MB, or sending more than 25 files at once. The “PDF to Word” tab adds its own constraint, as it only accepts the. PDF format. The storage areas remind you of these limits on the screen, just under the dispatch button.
etapes: Check the extension: only. PDF,. doc,. docx,. xls,. xlsx,. ppt, and. pptx are accepted for translation.
Verify that you are not on the tab “PDF to Word”, which only accepts the. PDF format.
Check the file weight: the limit is 50 MB per file.
Count your batch files: the limit is 25 files per submission.
Use the original file,. docx or. xlsx instead of a PDF: it is often lighter and better treated.
Replay the text in the safe deposit box, which displays the exact list of formats and the maximum size allowed.
savoir: The format and weight check faster than the content: always start with these two points.
A large scanned PDF is best converted into Word on the “PDF to Word” tab before any other operation.
The limits are identical in text translation, document and project management: a file that is rejected on the one hand will be rejected on the other.
articles.question: Why is my file rejected?

h1: Manage the organization, its members and their roles
lead: Add members, give them a role, get an entire team in their email domain and organize a group into girl organizations.
title: Organization, members and roles · help Centre · Neur.on
description: Administer Corrext: Admin roles, Project Manager and Member, add members, adhere by email domain, parent organizations, and daughters.

articles.titre: What roles can be assigned in an organization?
articles.question: What roles can be assigned in an organization?
articles.reponse: There are three roles in Corrext: Admin, Project Manager and Member. The role is chosen when adding a member, either individually or for an entire email domain.
savoir: The details of the rights attached to each role will be shown to you at the time of implementation.
Who takes care: the administrator of your organization.

articles.titre: How to add a member to the organization
articles.question: How can I add a member to the organization?
articles.reponse: The members of the organisation are listed in the “direct memberships” block, with their email address and role. The Add member button adds an address and assigns a role to it.
etapes: Open the members of your organization.
In “direct memberships”, click “Add member”.
Enter the email address and select the role: Admin, Project Manager, or Member.
Validez: the person appears in the list with his or her role.
savoir: Who takes care: the administrator of your organization.

articles.titre: How to automatically bring in an entire team
articles.question: How do I automatically get a whole team in?
articles.reponse: The Email domain memberships block associates an entire email domain with a role, with the add domain button. Anyone who logs in to an address in this domain joins the organization with this role.
savoir: Convenient for a practice or whole service: every newcomer is connected from the first time they log in.
Who takes care: the administrator of your organization.

articles.titre: How to organise a group, subsidiaries or offices
articles.question: How do you organise a group, subsidiaries or offices?
articles.reponse: An organization may have a parent organization and daughter organizations, with their own address or that of the parent. Two settings are not transmitted to daughter organizations: activation of terminology and confidentiality notice. They are determined for each organization.
savoir: Who takes care: the team Neur.on, set up or on request.

h1: Decide on motors and privacy notice
lead: Your organization's engine policy: the authorised engines, the notice displayed before being sent to a foreign engine, and the use of your own API keys.
title: Motors and privacy · helpdesk · Neur.on
description: Administer Corrext: engines allowed per organization, privacy notice before foreign engines, own API keys for DeepL, Claude and GPT.

articles.titre: How to choose the motors available to our users
articles.question: How do we choose the motors that are available to our users?
articles.reponse: Each organisation has its own list of authorised engines (“Allowed AI providers”). It is the organization's engine policy: a department that deals with sensitive issues can, for example, stick to LexMachina.
savoir: In Highly sensitive content mode, only Swiss engines remain selectable, regardless of the list.
Who takes care: the team Neur.on, set up or on request.

articles.titre: How to view a notice before sending to a foreign engine
articles.question: How do I view a notice before sending it to a foreign engine?
articles.reponse: The “Show confidentiality warning when non-CONFIDENTIAL engines are selected” setting displays the Attorney-Client privilege notice as soon as a user chooses an engine hosted abroad. It is organized by organization and does not pass on to girls' organizations.
savoir: The opinion recalls your organization's policy when selecting the engine in the tool.
Who takes care: the team Neur.on, set up or on request.

articles.titre: Can we use our own DeepL, Claude or GPT contracts?
articles.question: Can we use our own DeepL, Claude or GPT contracts?
articles.reponse: Yes. By default, Corrext uses its own access keys to these engines. An organization may provide its own API keys for DeepL, Claude and GPT, so that calls are made through its contracts with these suppliers.
savoir: Processing by these engines remains outside of Switzerland: the confidentiality notice applies in the same way.
Who takes care: the team Neur.on, set up or on request.

h1: Import your memories, bases and resources
lead: Translation memories, terminology and CHnell resources specific to your organization, so that Corrext is guided by your vocabulary.
title: Memoirs and terminology · helpdesk · Neur.on
description: Corrext administration: Import TMX memories, TBX or XML terminology databases, and add own resources to CHnell.

articles.titre: How to import our translation memories
articles.question: How can we import our translation memories?
articles.reponse: The organization's memoirs are managed in “Managing translation memories”. The Create button opens the import: you first choose categories, i.e. domains, and then file files in. tmx format, up to 5 MB per file.
savoir: Each memory remains attached to its domains, which can then be modified in the list.
Who takes care: the administrator of your organization, or the team Neur.on in setting up the organization.

articles.titre: How to import a terminology base
articles.question: How can I import a terminology base?
articles.reponse: The organisation's terminology bases are managed in “Management term bases”. The “Create” button accepts. TBX or. XML files, up to 5 MB per file.
savoir: To impose a term on a specific project, use the terminology stage of the project.
Who takes care: the administrator of your organization, or the team Neur.on in setting up the organization.

articles.titre: How to add our own resources to CHnell
articles.question: How can we add our own resources to CHnell?
articles.reponse: CHnell distinguishes between shared resources, from official sources, and resources specific to an organization, visible by itself. A document may be viewed in its entirety or only by extracts.
savoir: In Search, your resources appear distinguished from shared resources.
Who takes care: the team Neur.on, set up or on request.
